QuestInfo.name: Collect Lucky Cakes!
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra has something to say to you.
QuestInfo.1: If you collect Lucky Cakes and bring them to Cassandra, she'll give you a gift.
QuestInfo.2: You gave Cassandra some Lucky Cakes and got 1 Legends Awards Coin. It's your lucky day! What kind of special items will you get with your Legends Awards Coins?

0.0:
Welcome to the party! If there's anything you need, feel free to let me know! I'm happy to help! 
That reminds me. I prepared a special gift to you! I'm giving out Legends Awards Coins to anyone who brings me some Lucky Cakes. Do you want to join in the fun?

yes.0:
Bring me 50 Lucky Cakes and I'll give you a Legends Awards Coin. They say money can't by happiness, but I'm pretty sure these coins can. Trust me, I checked. 
If you want to join in the fun, let me know. And enjoy Legends!

no.0: Oh, okay. I understand. You're more of a pie person, right?

1.0:
Oh, you have 50 Lucky Cakes!
Thank you very much! 
Here, take this Legends Awards Coin. It'll help you have more fun. I'm sure of it!
I'd like you to have this.

item.0: Still working on those Lucky Cakes? Don't worry! I know you'll get me 50 of them in no time!

yes.0: Many good things will happen to you if you bring me more Lucky Cakes. Keep this up and you'll see what I mean. So, for now, have fun playing Legends!
